1838 is not a leap year (leap years are divisible by 4, but 1838/4=459.5).  
From 1838-09-11, add 362 days:  
Days remaining in September 1838: 30 - 11 = 19 days.  
Days left after September: 362 - 19 = 343 days.  
October to December 1838: 31+30+31 = 92 days → 343 - 92 = 251 days left for 1839.  
January to August 1839: 31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31 = 243 days → 251 - 243 = 8 days into September 1839.  
Thus new date = 1839-09-08.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1839-09-08
